text: Sea Limited's total revenue in FY2025 was $22,938,469 thousand (approximately $22.94 billion), up from $16,819,866 thousand in FY2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.96]. This was driven primarily by E-commerce (Shopee) revenue of $14,545,894 thousand (63.4% of total), Digital Financial Services (Monee) revenue of $3,791,641 thousand (16.6%), Digital Entertainment (Garena) revenue of $2,408,765 thousand (10.5%), Sales of goods of $2,025,408 thousand (8.8%), and Other Services of $166,761 thousand (0.7%) [Sea, FY2025, p.95].

answer: Sea Limited's total revenue in FY2025 was $22,938,469 thousand (approximately $22.94 billion), up from $16,819,866 thousand in FY2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.96]. This was driven primarily by E-commerce (Shopee) revenue of $14,545,894 thousand (63.4% of total), Digital Financial Services (Monee) revenue of $3,791,641 thousand (16.6%), Digital Entertainment (Garena) revenue of $2,408,765 thousand (10.5%), Sales of goods of $2,025,408 thousand (8.8%), and Other Services of $166,761 thousand (0.7%) [Sea, FY2025, p.95].
